summary: Preserve property Get timing and side effects while serializing object members.

target.notes: After the object's key list is chosen, each property is obtained with JS Get immediately before serializing that property. Getters may delete or change later properties; those later Gets observe the mutation.

semantics.getter_invocation: once when its selected key is processed unless hooks trigger additional user code
semantics.order: selected keys are processed in list order
semantics.mutation: deleting a later property before its turn causes its later Get to produce undefined and therefore omission
semantics.exceptions: getter exceptions abort serialization and propagate

caveats: Materializing all values before serialization changes side-effect ordering.

tests.name: getter can delete later selected property
